context.aboutText: Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind, i18n with next-intl.

float.note1: Next.js 16 with Cache Components: both language versions are static HTML, and GitHub data is cached on the server hourly.
float.note2: Pinned work section where vertical scroll drives translateX via requestAnimationFrame, no libraries.
float.note3: Terminal: the command parser is a pure, unit-tested function; the component applies its effects (theme, language, navigation).
float.note4: Character rain on '<'canvas'>', paused while the tab is hidden and off with prefers-reduced-motion.
float.note5: 3D flip cards in CSS (preserve-3d + backface-visibility) with the hidden face marked inert.
float.note6: Contact form uses a Server Action with server-side zod validation, a honeypot and Resend.

hint: tip: press '' to open the terminal and 1–5 to jump between sections
